task_prompt: Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.62, 0.35, 0.49, 0.42] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
